title: What the code can't tell an agent
summary: Part 1 of Agents on the team: company notes that people maintain and agents read, so our agents know what the code can't show them. Includes a setup prompt for your own team.
body_markdown:
index.md


The map agents start from


```text
# wonderby-headquarters


- [Business and product](business-and-product/overview.md)
- [Development](development/overview.md)
- [Marketing](marketing/overview.md)
- [Design](design/overview.md)
- [Support](support/overview.md)
```


business-and-product/


Business and product


CEO


Updates when the audience, product, or company rules change


The CEO will update` business-and-product/overview.md` when our audience, product, or company rules change. It will explain our wider audience of service businesses, beyond salons, and wording rules such as saying "business" in customer copy instead of our internal term "supplier". They'll record changes in direction, launches, and things we discontinue in` business-and-product/changelog.md` .


development/


Development


Developer leading the work


Updates when priorities or release status change


The developer leading the work will update` development/overview.md` when priorities or release status change, including what's available on web, Android, and iOS. They'll record meaningful changes and release confirmations in` development/changelog.md` . Coding rules will stay in each codebase's own instructions.


marketing/


Marketing


Person running the campaign


Updates when a campaign starts or its message changes


When a campaign starts or its message changes, the person running it will update the audience, message, and material in` marketing/overview.md` . They'll record changes and results in` marketing/changelog.md` .


design/


Design


The designer


Updates when we approve a design


When we approve a design, its designer will update` design/overview.md` with the decision and Figma link, then record the reason in` design/changelog.md` .


support/


Support


Person handling support


Updates when we confirm a problem, release a fix, or change our advice


When we confirm a problem, release a fix, or change our advice, the person handling support will update the answers in` support/overview.md` and record what changed in` support/changelog.md` .
